reason: The root-difficulty example targets a fixed RNJ tolerance. A cheaper RNJ tolerance choice may already fix it and must be compared before claiming WZZT-specific value.
data_scope: same training observations, one fitted R/X pair reused; validation only for model choice; frozen independent test only for final evaluation
weights: each algorithm-generated RNJ family plus singletons fitted by the same nonnegative fixed-support L1, with same bounds as WZZT
selection: all declared RNJ variants and WZZT path points use the same held-out block MAE/SE and common one-SE rule; original fixed-0.16 RNJ and WZZT-only outcomes retained
truth_usage: post-selection recovery counts only, never choose tolerance by test truth
claim_boundary: If tolerance selection fixes the same root errors with comparable validation/test performance, report the cheaper explanation and do not claim WZZT is indispensable on this example.
